text: Stopwatch shall measure how far the clinic tablet's recorded waits differ from a stopwatch, and say so honestly.
The harness shall record a model under a fake realtime clock and replay its decision log under run().
A deterministic model shall replay with every decision matching, injections included, at any scale.
rationale: SPEC H1. Same-time injections are where record and replay can part.

text: Replay shall report a mismatch when a model decides with Math.random, a different seed, or a missing decision.
The study shall time patients with one observer for at most the manager's mornings and report an interval and a verdict.
The study shall never ask for an impossible timing or a morning past the limit, and shall return a well-formed report.
acceptance: T-S1-SAFE passes on 200 stand-in clinics of five loads.

text: The interval shall hold the true mean difference in 90% to 99% of clinics at alpha 0.05, with mean error under one minute.
rationale: SPEC S2. Measured on our stand-in clinic, not the lab's.

text: The verdict shall follow the interval in the order SPEC S3 gives, with the 2-minute band inclusive.
The same seed on the same clinic shall give the same report, and the study's log shall replay through the harness.

The report shall add one warning clause when the timed differences drift with wait, or when the timed patients waited 5 minutes or more less than the rest by the tablet, and shall leave the interval and the verdict unchanged.
rationale: ta-a63ca2 (Morphyx). SPEC promises differences independent of waits; the study leans on it (fi-85326e). The drift test fires about alpha of the time under the promise.

text: Evidence shall stop counting when a file it depended on changes.
Changing one implementing file shall drop exactly the evidence that depended on it, and leave the rest.
The project shall be measured by vv on its own requirements.
Every link shall name a real check, and every check shall verify a requirement.
rationale: A link to a check that doesn't run is a verification nobody did.
